notes: Book already spans all four growth-and-inflation quadrants; only new, non-duplicate addition is a short-duration Treasury sleeve (stage-3 top ballast) sized small, funded from idle cash.

rule_cited: Long-Term Debt Cycle stage-3 rubric (cash gets temporarily un-trashed at the top) + Diversification is the holy grail
teach: Short-term government bonds barely move in price, giving a portfolio a calm place to sit when everything else gets shaky.
why: Stocks and long bonds are wobbling together while short-term rates sit near four percent, so a safer short-term bond adds real ballast.
